chip.description: Motorola 68000 with built-in encryption of both opcodes and data, keyed by battery-backed internal RAM; the FD1089B variant of the decryption tables.
chip.notes: src/mame/sega/fd1089.cpp in MAME 0.288; MAME device full name "Hitachi FD1089B Encrypted CPU". Classified cpu by the taxonomy §6 FD1094 adjudication (TB1, TB6).
